about: the edit endpoint answers with OpenAI's real retirement error (404) and the image API with a 502 HTML page

responses.retired: OpenAI's Edits API (/v1/edits, text-davinci-edit-001), shut down by OpenAI in January 2024; answered as it answered

error.message: The model `text-davinci-edit-001` has been deprecated, learn more here: https://platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations

connector.none: no Claude connector for OpenAI edits; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: legacy OpenAI node, operation edit: POST /v1/edits {model: text-davinci-edit-001, input, instruction}. Not a chat endpoint, so the model shim does not answer it; the reply is fixed here. The default openAiApi base URL is https://api.openai.com/v1, so the mock intercepts TLS; chat/completions calls are left unrouted so the mock forwards them to the model shim

connector.none: image generation stays with the provider (media lever)

reads.note: legacy OpenAI node, resource image: POST /v1/images/generations {prompt, n: 4, size: 512x512, response_format: b64_json} (response format binaryData); the node turns each b64_json into a binary item

branches: no IF/Switch; LoadMP3 and Whisper-transcribe are disabled, so the manual item passes through them to Text-example (static transcript) and every branch runs once
davinci-003-edit and DALLE-ex3.3 are expected to fail (n8n's OpenAI node throws on 4xx/5xx); the other branches still run
